verdict.rationale: uv documents a strong caching model (aggressive dependency caching, configurable cache-keys, cache clean commands) and explicitly recommends the official `astral-sh/setup-uv` GitHub Action which 'installs uv, adds it to PATH, (optionally) persists the cache' for CI, plus guidance for Python version pinning and matrix testing in CI — directly supporting fast, reproducible CI installs. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of an offline/--no-index install mode or air-gapped install workflow, and one community report (uvx redownloading dependencies repeatedly) suggests cache reuse isn't always seamless. Missing for 10: explicit offline-install documentation/flags, independent benchmark data on CI cache-restore speedups, and resolution of the redownload-cache community complaint.
